description: This file defines a custom exception class 'OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException' used within the Orleans runtime to indicate failure in cluster connectivity checks.

classes.name: OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception thrown when a cluster connectivity check fails, inheriting from OrleansException.

methods.name: OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a default message.

methods.name: OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message and an inner exception.
